format: C++ / CUDA / Metal shader pipeline code
description: This file implements various optimized attention operations for Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend in PyTorch, including general, vectorized, and full attention modes. It handles tensor shape adjustments, memory management, and dispatches GPU computations through Metal command encoders and pipeline states, with special handling for macOS 15 and newer architectures.

classes.name: CachedGraph
classes.description: A cache container for computations graph related to attention, holds references to various tensors involved in the GPU graph execution.

methods.name: ensure_4d
methods.description: Adjusts tensor shape to 4D if necessary, unsqueezing or reshaping for batch processing.

methods.name: sdpa_general_mps
methods.description: Performs general (non-optimized) scaled dot-product attention using MPS graph API, handling masking, scaling, and causality.

methods.name: sdpa_vector_fast_mps
methods.description: Executes a fast vectorized attention mode in a single GPU pass on MPS, optimized for short sequences.

methods.name: sdpa_vector_2pass_mps
methods.description: Runs a two-pass vectorized attention for better numerical stability on short sequences.

methods.name: sdpa_full_attention_mps
methods.description: Performs full, standard attention operation via MPS, suitable for general use when optimizations don't apply.

methods.name: _scaled_dot_product_attention_math_mps
methods.description: Main entry point that selects optimized or general attention modes based on input shape and parameters, dispatching to specific implementations.
